title: Numbers up to 999: Hundreds, Tens and Units
seo_title: Numbers up to 999 – Primary 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Count, read and write numbers from 1 to 999 in figures and in words; identify the place value of hundreds, tens and units. (summary of the NERDC Primary 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 3 maths worksheets on numbers up to 999: hundreds, tens and units, reading and writing numbers in figures and words, and counting on and back. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A three-digit number has hundreds, tens and units: 472 = 4 hundreds, 7 tens and 2 units.
  • 472 = 400 + 70 + 2. We say four hundred and seventy-two.
  • A zero keeps a place empty: 305 has 3 hundreds, 0 tens and 5 units.

Examples

Example

What is 6 hundreds, 0 tens and 8 units?

600 + 0 + 8

Answer: 608

Example

Value of 5 in 352

5 is in the tens place

Answer: 50

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Writing 400702 for four hundred and seventy-twoWrite 472.
Forgetting the zeroThree hundred and five is 305, not 35.
Mixing up tens and unitsThe units digit is on the right.

items.q: Write eight hundred and two in numerals.
items.e: Eight hundred and two means 8 hundreds, 0 tens, 2 units: 800 + 2 = 802. Write 0 in the tens place. 3-digit numbers have only 3 digits, so it is not 8,002.

items.q: Write six hundred and thirty-eight in numerals.
items.e: Six hundred and thirty-eight means 6 hundreds, 3 tens, 8 units: 600 + 30 + 8 = 638.
400 + 7 is 4 hundreds, 0 tens and 7 units. Write 0 in the tens place: 407.

items.e: Four hundred and thirteen means 4 hundreds, 1 ten, 3 units: 400 + 10 + 3 = 413.

items.q: Which number would you say when counting in 4s from 0?
items.e: 7 × 4 = 28, so you say 28 when counting in 4s: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28. 26, 18 and 34 are in the 2 times table, but not the 4 times table.
10 more than 295: change the tens digit. 295 + 10 = 305. 9 tens and 1 more ten make 10 tens = 1 hundred, so the hundreds digit goes up too.

items.q: Count in 4s: 12, 16, ☐, 24, 28. What number goes in the box?
items.e: The numbers go up by 4 each time. 16 + 4 = 20. Check: 20 + 4 = 24.
10 less than 503: change the tens digit. 503 − 10 = 493. There are 0 tens, so take 1 ten from the hundreds: 5 hundreds → 4 hundreds and 9 tens.

items.q: Count back in 50s: 500, 450, 400, 350, ? What comes next?
items.e: Each number is 50 less than the one before. 350 − 50 = 300.

items.q: Which number would you say when counting in 8s from 0?
items.e: 8 × 8 = 64. 68 is in the 4 times table but not the 8 times table. 54 and 58 end in 4 and 8 but are not multiples of 8.
100 less than 140: change the hundreds digit. 140 − 100 = 40. 1 hundred take away 1 hundred leaves 0 hundreds, so the answer has only 2 digits.
